No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Leather Technologists Honour Outstanding Professionals by Gabi Hibbatullah 43 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The Society of Leather Technologists and Chemists of Nigeria (SLTCN) has honoured outstanding members for their contributions to the growth of Nigeria’s leather industry.
The maiden Awards Night, held ahead of the Society’s 9th Annual Conference, drew members, industry stakeholders and distinguished guests.
Speaking at the ceremony, the National President of SLTCN, Dr Jeremiah Irrimiya Tagang, said the awards fulfilled a long-anticipated aspiration of the Society.
He said the recognition was a way of thanking professionals whose dedication and service had shaped the leather industry.
“The award was established to recognise outstanding contributions, dedication, professional excellence and commitment to the growth of the leather industry and the objectives of the Society.”
The event was organised to celebrate excellence and preserve the legacies of those who contributed to the profession’s growth.
The award categories included Fellows, Honorary Fellows and Posthumous Fellows.
Among those honoured were Dr J. I. Tagang, Dr J. D. Putshaka, Dr S. F. Tanko, Dr A. Ejila and Mr C. C. Maju.
Also honoured was Dr Auwal Mustapha Imam, the Director-General/Chief Executive Officer of the Nigerian Institute of Leather and Science Technology (NILEST), Zaria, in recognition of his outstanding contributions to science, leadership and national development.
The maiden Awards Night marked a significant milestone in SLTCN’s history. It reaffirmed the Society’s commitment to celebrating excellence, rewarding service and inspiring the next generation of leather technologists and chemists to uphold professionalism, innovation and dedication.
